fpstudio.gui.title: FP Studio
fpstudio.gui.tip.addkey: Key at playhead on the selected track
fpstudio.gui.tip.mirror: Copy the selected arm to the other one, mirrored
fpstudio.gui.tip.etype: Left/right click to change event type
fpstudio.gui.hint.grab: Hold G and move the mouse to move the arm. G+R rotates. G+wheel moves forward/back. Camera: G rotates, G+Shift moves. Hold Shift while dragging for fine control.
fpstudio.gui.hint.swing_main: Swings the main hand - visible to other players.
fpstudio.gui.hint.use: Right-clicks whatever the crosshair points at: place a block, open a door or chest, use the held item.
fpstudio.gui.hint.attack: Left-clicks the crosshair target: breaks a block or hits an entity.
fpstudio.gui.hint.impact: Strength of the camera and hand kick, default 1.
fpstudio.gui.hint.none: Double-click a row to add a key (a channel row keys just that channel, a track row keys all). Drag a box to select several keys and move them together. Right-click for the menu. Fastest: Templates tab or Rec (E).
fpstudio.gui.hint.keys: Space - play/pause|K - add key|Double-click - add key|Box / Shift - select|Drag key - move (curves: value too)|Right-click - menu (interpolation)|Ctrl+A / C / V / D - all/copy/paste/duplicate|Alt+Left/Right - nudge keys|Del - delete|Q - tracks/curves|F - fit|B - bars|G - move arm with mouse|E - record|Ctrl+Z / Y - undo|Ctrl+S - save|M - mirror|Enter - fullscreen|Tab - go in world|Ctrl+wheel - zoom|Middle drag - pan|Ctrl +/- - interface size
fpstudio.gui.hint.events_warn: With World events on, attack/use/sound fire for real right from the studio. Fullscreen preview always runs events.
fpstudio.gui.tip.rec: Record mouse movement into the selected track
fpstudio.gui.toast.rec_track: Select an arm or camera track first
fpstudio.gui.hint.templates: Ready-made moves: click to insert into the clip and preview. Chain them to build a scene in seconds.
fpstudio.gui.tip.tpl_rest: At the end the hands glide back to the normal pose
fpstudio.gui.tpl_tip.inspect: Both hands rise and turn in front of you
fpstudio.gui.tpl_tip.punch: Right punch + attack event and camera kick
fpstudio.gui.tpl_tip.place: Hand forward + use event (right click at crosshair)
fpstudio.gui.tpl_tip.show_item: Held item rises toward the camera
fpstudio.gui.tpl_tip.cover: Both hands cover the face + kick
fpstudio.gui.tpl_tip.hit_taken: Camera only: sharp kick and roll
fpstudio.gui.tpl_tip.look_hands: Camera tilts down, hands in front
fpstudio.gui.tip.stage: Close the studio but keep hands and camera live: walk and look around. Press O to come back
fpstudio.gui.tip.walk_preview: Events (walking, strikes) run when previewing from the studio
fpstudio.gui.hint.walk: The player walks by itself. Format: forward|back|left|right and speed 0-1, e.g. forward,0.6. Set the length with the slider.
fpstudio.gui.hint.turn: Smoothly turns the player. Format: yaw,pitch in degrees (right and down are positive), e.g. 90,0.
fpstudio.gui.hint.sneak: The player sneaks for the whole event.
fpstudio.gui.hint.sprint: Sprint; place together with a Walk event.
fpstudio.gui.tpl_tip.pickup: Hand reaches down-forward, use, lifts to camera
fpstudio.gui.tpl_tip.drink: Held item to the face, camera tilts up slightly
fpstudio.gui.tpl_tip.dramatic_reveal: Hands slowly rise from below, camera eases back
fpstudio.gui.tpl_tip.hero_landing: Camera dips, hands out, heavy kick and sound
fpstudio.gui.tpl_tip.sword_slash: Overhead wind-up and diagonal strike with an attack event
fpstudio.gui.tpl_tip.combo: Left, right, then a double uppercut
fpstudio.gui.tpl_tip.charge: Hands tremble at the body, FOV narrows, then a thrust forward
fpstudio.gui.tpl_tip.shield: Cross hands in front, camera flinches
fpstudio.gui.tpl_tip.stumble: Camera and hands sway, the player turns slightly
fpstudio.gui.tpl_tip.whip_turn: The player spins 180 degrees in half a second
fpstudio.gui.tpl_tip.dolly_zoom: Camera moves forward while FOV grows: the vertigo effect
fpstudio.gui.tpl_tip.sprint: The player sprints for 3 s, hands pump, camera bobs
fpstudio.gui.tpl_tip.dash: Short forward dash with a FOV stretch
fpstudio.gui.tpl_tip.slow_walk: The player walks slowly, hands sway gently
fpstudio.gui.tpl_tip.door_walk: Walks to a door, right-clicks and walks on
fpstudio.gui.tpl_tip.ledge_jump: Jump and a step forward, hands reach up
fpstudio.gui.tpl_tip.look_around: The player turns left, right and back
fpstudio.gui.hint.freeze: Freeze all input: during fullscreen playback you cannot walk, look around, press keys, open the inventory or chat. The clip drives the player. Exit with Esc or P. Global switch: freezeInputDuringAnimation in the config.
fpstudio.gui.hint.lock: Lock controls: during the animation you cannot walk, look around, press buttons or scroll. This is the clip's own setting. 'Lock in all clips' applies it to every animation. Exit any time: Esc or P.
fpstudio.gui.tip.bars: Black bars at top and bottom on/off
fpstudio.gui.graph.only_arms: Curves: pick an arm or camera track
fpstudio.gui.npc.hint: Put your Blockbench (GeckoLib) export in the folder: NAME/NAME.geo.json, a skin .png and animation.json. Then press Reload.
fpstudio.gui.npc.empty: Empty. Press Folder and drop the files there.
fpstudio.gui.npc.add_tip: Add to the scene in front of you
fpstudio.gui.npc.no_actor: No NPCs in the scene. Add one from the library.
fpstudio.gui.npc.pick: Pick an NPC in the list.
fpstudio.gui.npc.here_tip: Place the NPC in front of you, facing you
fpstudio.gui.npc.missing: Model not found in the library
fpstudio.gui.npc.idle_tip: Animation while nothing else plays (left/right click cycles)
fpstudio.gui.npc.cue_tip: Place at the playhead and play
fpstudio.gui.npc.bones_hint: * hides/shows a body part (left click: with everything attached, right click: only that bone). The name selects the bone: it is highlighted in the world and its track appears on the timeline. G + mouse rotates the bone, G + Shift moves it.
fpstudio.gui.hint.npc_anim: Plays an NPC animation. Length 0 keeps it going until that NPC's next animation.
fpstudio.gui.hint.cam_look: The camera turns smoothly to the NPC (or one of its bones). Length 0 = until the end of the clip.
fpstudio.gui.tip.type_value: Click to type any number (it can exceed the slider range)
fpstudio.gui.npc.eye_tip: Hide/show bone. Left click: with children, right click: only this one
fpstudio.gui.tip.hands: Hands slide off screen / come back at the playhead
fpstudio.gui.hint.hands: The hands glide off screen or come back. 'To' is where they go, 'From' is where they come in from. Custom: set the offset and tilt yourself (values can be typed; right hand, the left is mirrored). Scrub the timeline to preview.
fpstudio.gui.tip.hands_dir: Direction the hands leave / enter (left/right click cycles). Custom = set the point yourself
fpstudio.gui.tip.rec_move: Record the player's movement in the world (walking, jumps, looking) along with the clip
fpstudio.gui.tip.rec_mode: Click to switch the recording method
fpstudio.gui.hint.rec_camera: Your path and view become keys of the Camera track: move them, change the angle, easing and everything else like any camera. The player stands still during playback, only the camera moves.
fpstudio.gui.hint.rec_events: Your path is recorded as Walk / Turn / Jump events: the player really walks through the world when played.
fpstudio.gui.tip.cam_apply: Rebuild the camera keys from the take with these settings (replaces keys in the recorded span)
fpstudio.gui.tip.cam_smooth_keys: Smooth and simplify all camera keys with these settings
fpstudio.gui.hint.cam: Anchor: the camera flies to the place in the world where the take started and goes on from there, wherever you stand. Before the start it glides there over the fly-in time, and back at the end. Smoothing: 0 = as recorded (harsh), 0.3-0.6 = smooth, 1+ = very soft. Key precision: lower = more keys, closer to the take. Set the values, then Apply to take. Smooth current keys also works after hand edits.
fpstudio.gui.toast.no_raw: No take: record the camera first (Move button)
fpstudio.gui.toast.cam_recorded: Recorded! Set the smoothing and press Apply to take
fpstudio.gui.tip.hands_shown: Which hands are visible in the clip (left/right click cycles). New clips start with the right hand only
fpstudio.gui.npc.name: Name
fpstudio.gui.npc.edit_anim: Edit this animation in the studio (bones and keys)
fpstudio.gui.npc.anim_hint: Empty = auto-detect by name (idle/walk/run/talk/sit). Shift+click a button cycles backwards.
fpstudio.gui.npc.need_creative: The studio only works in creative
fpstudio.gui.npc.edit_ready: Scene ready: edit bones and keys, then Export
fpstudio.gui.npc.export_tip: Bakes the animation plus your bone edits into a new animation (name_edit) in the model folder
fpstudio.gui.npc.export_none: This NPC has no animation event
fpstudio.gui.chat.title: Chat
fpstudio.gui.chat.font_note: Your own fonts: drop .ttf/.otf files into the fonts folder (created on first launch at config/fpstudio/chat_fonts) and press Apply. Fonts from resource packs are listed below too.
fpstudio.gui.chat.icon_note: Format: file name from the icon folder, player:Name, item:minecraft:apple, or empty. Put PNG files into the icon folder.
fpstudio.gui.chat.no_icons: The folder is empty: drop PNG files there (square works best).
fpstudio.gui.chat.rules_note: If a message matches the pattern (regex) you can set an icon, recolour [Name] or hide it.
fpstudio.gui.chat.rule_cols: Row 1: pattern. Row 2: icon, colour, show/hide. Row 3: effects for the whole message (shake=1;glitch).
fpstudio.gui.chat.s_player: Hello! This is a normal player message.
fpstudio.gui.chat.s_npc1: Besides, Riz is clearly the type who loves attention.
fpstudio.gui.chat.s_npc2: Or I will have my own cool bunker where I can breathe without a silly diving suit.
fpstudio.gui.chat.anchor_hint: Click a cell to pin the chat to that part of the screen.
fpstudio.gui.chat.drag_hint: Tip: drag the chat on the mini screen, drag the frame edge to resize, wheel scales, arrow keys nudge 1 px (Shift 5), Ctrl+Z undoes.
fpstudio.gui.chat.anim_note: The In-game preview mode shows the real appear and fade animations.
fpstudio.gui.chat.ttf_note: Drop .ttf/.otf files into the fonts folder and .ogg sounds into the sounds folder, then press Apply. Fonts show up in the list as fpstudio_user:name. Size/shift are applied on Apply.
fpstudio.gui.chat.type_note: Letters appear one by one and each can blip. The [Name]: part shows at once.
fpstudio.gui.chat.voices_note: The first matching pattern (regex over the message text) picks the voice, e.g. ^\[Sans\] — one blip per character.
fpstudio.gui.chat.voice_map_note: Example: aeiou=minecraft:block.note_block.pling@1.3; mnb=fpstudio_user:blip.low@0.8 — your .ogg files from the sounds folder are fpstudio_user:blip.file_name.
fpstudio.gui.chat.fx_note: Write in the text: <shake>shaky</shake>. Tags can nest: <wave><glow>text</glow></wave>. </> closes the last tag. Works in NPC lines (say), from players and in rules.
fpstudio.gui.chat.fx_args: Arguments: <shake=2> strength; <glow=1,#7FD0FF> strength and colour; <color=#FF8800>. In a rule (3rd row) you can set effects for the whole message: shake=1;glitch.
fpstudio.gui.chat.gif_note: Drop .gif files into the GIF folder (config/fpstudio/chat_gifs). In text: <gif=name> or <gif=name,24> (size in pixels). As a message icon: gif:name. Click to copy the tag.
fpstudio.gui.chat.no_gifs: The folder is empty: drop .gif files there.
fpstudio.gui.chat.base_fx_note: Names: shake, wave, glitch, flicker, blood, glow, ghost, corrupt, rainbow, robot, color. Separate with ";", strength after "=".
fpstudio.gui.chat.scr_hold: Keep on screen in the preview
fpstudio.gui.chat.scr_help: Command: /fpscreen show @a name 5 Text (5 = seconds, -1 = as in the preset). Remove: /fpscreen clear @a. NPC script: screen name 5 Text. Needs operator rights or creative. Presets are stored in the world folder.
fpstudio.gui.chat.scr_sample: Hello! This is <shake>text</shake> on the screen.
fpstudio.stage.hint: World mode: O - studio, P - play clip
fpstudio.msg.lock_hint: Controls locked. Esc or P to stop
fpstudio.msg.creative_only: FP Studio only works in creative mode
fpstudio.msg.rec_count: Recording starts... get to your start spot. O or P cancels
fpstudio.msg.rec_hint: Recording movement. Press O or P to finish
key.fpstudio.npc: NPC editor (look at an NPC / create new)
fpstudio.msg.npc_no_permission: Creative mode or operator rights required
fpstudio.msg.npc_not_npc: That is not an FP Studio NPC
